test_0001_base32_padding.note: Python's base32 decoder accepts padded input that the Rust core rejects.

test_0002_base32_spare_bits.error: non-zero spare bits in the last base32 character
test_0002_base32_spare_bits.note: The Go port accepted this alias of ISCC:GAAAAAAAAA while Rust rejected it.

test_0003_base32_spare_bits_iscc_code.error: non-zero spare bits in the last base32 character
test_0003_base32_spare_bits_iscc_code.note: An ISCC-CODE whose last base32 character carries non-zero spare bits is a non-canonical alias.

test_0004_canonical_unit.note: The canonical form of the base32 aliases above decodes to a zero Data-Code digest.

test_0005_empty_string.note: Empty input must be rejected; the reference raises IndexError, the Rust core rejects it.

test_0006_unit_above_256.note: The reference encoder's 288-bit Meta-Code (header 00 08 00, 36-byte body). iscc-lib 0.7.0 decoded it; the bound rejects it, and iscc-core raises '288 is not a valid LN'.

test_0001_long_s_case_fold.error: non-ASCII letter that Unicode upper-cases to ASCII
test_0001_long_s_case_fold.note: Unicode upper-casing maps the long s to S, so iscc-core reads an alias that ASCII-only casing rejects.
test_0001_long_s_case_fold.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-18: Codec input is upper-cased ASCII-only, encode_seq included

test_0002_sharp_s_case_fold.error: non-ASCII letter that Unicode upper-cases to ASCII
test_0002_sharp_s_case_fold.note: Unicode upper-casing maps the sharp s to SS, so iscc-core reads an alias that ASCII-only casing rejects.
test_0002_sharp_s_case_fold.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-18: Codec input is upper-cased ASCII-only, encode_seq included

test_0003_ascii_twin.note: The lower-case ASCII twin of the case-fold aliases encodes on every surface.

test_0004_empty_list.error: at least one ISCC-UNIT is required
test_0004_empty_list.note: An empty unit list must be rejected rather than encoded as an empty sequence.

test_0005_embedded_nul.error: embedded NUL followed by trailing data
test_0005_embedded_nul.note: C-string marshalling cuts the unit at the NUL and would encode the valid prefix.

test_0006_base32_spare_bits.error: non-zero spare bits in the last base32 character
test_0006_base32_spare_bits.note: The Go port accepted this alias of ISCC:GAAAAAAAAA while Rust rejected it.

test_0007_base32_spare_bits_256.error: non-zero spare bits in the last base32 character
test_0007_base32_spare_bits_256.note: A 256-bit unit whose last base32 character carries non-zero spare bits is a non-canonical alias.

test_0008_base32_padding.note: Python's base32 decoder accepts padded input that the Rust core rejects.

test_0001_embedded_nul.note: C-string marshalling cut the text at the NUL; .NET and C++ reject it by decision.

test_0001_empty_list.error: at least two Content-Codes are required
test_0001_empty_list.note: An empty code list must be rejected rather than mixed into an empty digest.

test_0002_bits_below_one_byte.error: bits is not a valid Content-Code length
test_0002_bits_below_one_byte.note: A bits value below 8 leaves no byte for the digest and must be rejected rather than indexing an empty buffer.

test_0001_empty_list.error: at least two ISCC-UNITs are required
test_0001_empty_list.note: An empty unit list must be rejected rather than composed into an empty ISCC-CODE.
An empty digest list must be rejected rather than hashed into 32 zero bytes.

test_0002_even_count_tie.note: A bit set in exactly half of the digests is a tie, and the reference sets the output bit (count >= n/2).

test_0001_raw_jcs_characters.note: The Go port escaped &, <, >, U+2028 and U+2029 in canonical meta JSON, where RFC 8785 writes them raw.

test_0002_utf16_key_order.note: The Go port sorted canonical meta JSON keys by UTF-8 bytes, where RFC 8785 sorts by UTF-16 code units (U+1F600 before U+E000).

test_0003_negative_zero.note: The Go port wrote a negative zero as -0 in canonical meta JSON, where RFC 8785 writes 0.

test_0004_meta_payload_over_limit.error: canonical meta payload of 128001 bytes exceeds META_TRIM_META (128000 bytes)
test_0004_meta_payload_over_limit.note: The Go port returned a Meta-Code for a meta payload over the 128,000-byte limit that the Rust core and iscc-core reject.

test_0005_bits_above_256.note: iscc-core returns a Meta-Code whose header claims a 288-bit unit, which no ISCC-UNIT may carry (iscc/iscc-core#142).
test_0005_bits_above_256.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-22: A unit is at most 256 bits

test_0001_equal_length.note: The equal-length twin of the ragged vector: every surface must decode nested frame signatures with non-zero values.

test_0002_ragged_frame_sigs.error: frame signatures must all have the same length
test_0002_ragged_frame_sigs.note: iscc-core truncates frame signatures of unequal length to the shortest, so a malformed input still yields a code.
test_0002_ragged_frame_sigs.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-21: Video frame signatures of unequal length are rejected, where iscc-core truncates

test_0001_small_average_many_chunks.note: The smallest accepted average cuts 32 bytes into 17 chunks of 1 to 3 bytes, which pins the cut-point masks and the minimum chunk size (the maximum, 16 bytes, is never reached).

test_0002_largest_average_all_reference_.note: 2^29 - 1 is the largest average the compiled iscc-core build accepts (it types the mask as uint32_t); input shorter than the minimum chunk stays one chunk.

test_0003_empty_input.note: Empty input yields one empty chunk, as in the reference, not an empty list.

test_0001_short_digest.note: iscc-core slices a short digest and emits a unit whose header claims more bits than its body holds.
test_0001_short_digest.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-22: encode_component rejects a digest shorter than bit_length/8

test_0002_exact_length_digest.note: A digest of exactly bit_length/8 bytes encodes to the same unit on every surface and in iscc-core.

test_0003_bit_length_above_256.note: iscc-core encodes a 288-bit unit that its own decoder rejects as an invalid length (iscc/iscc-core#142).
test_0003_bit_length_above_256.diverges: decisions.md 2026-11-22: A unit is at most 256 bits

test_0004_bit_length_256.note: A 256-bit unit is the longest one, and it encodes the same on every surface and in iscc-core.

test_0001_empty_list.note: An empty feature list must be rejected rather than hashed into 32 0xFF bytes.

test_0002_four_features.note: Features at both ends of the uint32 range hash to the same digest on every surface and in iscc-core.
